fields.name: Duplicate_phone_no
fields.expression:
-- 1. Check if ph_clustersize is greater than 1.
-- 2. If true, return "Duplicate Accounts-Phone_no".
-- 3. If false, return NULL.

IIF(ph_clustersize > 1, 'Duplicate Accounts-Phone_no', NULL)
fields.userPrompt: if ph_cluster_size is greater than 1 the give statement Duplicate Accounts-Phone_no

fields.name: Duplicate_Serial_No
